title: Photograph 4
passage: A. A worker is watering plants on the lowest shelf. B. A worker is holding a tray of plants at the level of a shelf. C. All of the trays have been placed on the ground. D. A worker is kneeling beneath the cart.
passageZh:
A. 一名作業員正在替最下面那層架上的植物澆水。
B. 一名作業員端著一盤植物，托盤大致與一層架板同高。
C. 所有托盤都已放在地上。
D. 一名作業員跪在推車下方。
audioScript: A. A worker is watering plants on the lowest shelf. B. A worker is holding a tray of plants at the level of a shelf. C. All of the trays have been placed on the ground. D. A worker is kneeling beneath the cart.
